summary: Query route: honor sessions.scope_override as retrieval scope, falling back to user prefs
description: In src/app/api/query/route.ts: extend the ownership SELECT (~line 93) to also pull scope_override; when non-NULL, use it in place of loadPreferences() output for retrieve() scoping (scopeMode/blocked/whitelisted fields only — preferredModel/preferredVoice still come from live prefs/session as today). NULL scope_override = existing behavior, zero change for normal sessions. Done: test covering override-used vs fallback-to-prefs paths.

resolution.test_function: scope_override on a forked session drives retrieval scoping, not live prefs
resolution.note: RetrievalScope type (scope subset of UserPreferences); ownership SELECT pulls scope_override; scopedPrefs = {...prefs, ...override} feeds retrieve() and prompt builders while preferredModel/preferredVoice keep reading live prefs. NULL = unchanged behavior, covered by explicit fallback test. Full suite 603 passed.
